page_title: NIC 2-3 MON | Nice v Monaco 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' It's like he was asking for a caution. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) receives a yellow card.
90+7' Pablo Rosario (Nice) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the left post.
90+7' The resulting corner from Romain Perraud (Nice) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Mohamed Camara is replaced by Edan Diop (Monaco).
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
90+2' Yellow card! It's like Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Eric Wattellier agrees and books him.
90+1' Excellent touch by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
88' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
86' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the left post.

85' Evann Guessand (Nice) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Eric Wattellier with no other option than to blow for a foul.
83' It's time for a substitution. Valentin Rosier (Nice) comes on in place of Morgan Sanson.
83' Evann Guessand (Nice) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
83' Eric Wattellier has issued a yellow card to Denis Zakaria (Monaco).
80' Adi Hutter has decided to make a change. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) replaces Aleksandr Golovin.
79' Substitution. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Takumi Minamino walks off.
77' 2 - 3 Goal! Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:3.

77' Excellent touch by Thilo Kehrer (Monaco)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Romain Perraud (Nice) is coming onto the pitch as Hicham Boudaoui cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Gaetan Laborde and he is replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice).

74' 2 - 2 Morgan Sanson sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Evann Guessand (Nice), who outjumps the defence to put the ball into the roof of the net with a stunning header. The score is 2:2.
74' Morgan Sanson (Nice) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
73' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) is penalised for holding. Eric Wattellier signals a set piece.
69' Flag goes up against Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
67' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Tom Louchet will be replaced by Khephren Thuram (Nice).
67' It is time for a substitution. Pablo Rosario (Nice) is on for Jordan Lotomba.
67' It must be a yellow card. It is. Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
66' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
60' A yellow card for a tackle by Tom Louchet (Nice). Eric Wattellier doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
54' RED card! Dante (Nice) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

54' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Dante (Nice), but referee Eric Wattellier must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
53' Looks like Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
50' 1 - 2 Goooooal! Takumi Minamino beats his man and slings in a cross towards Denis Zakaria (Monaco), who evades his marker and plants a fine header into the bottom left corner from close in. 1:2.
47' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The whistle blows and Eric Wattellier starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

45+3' Evann Guessand (Nice) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Philipp Kohn allowed him to make a comfortable save.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
39' The resulting corner from Morgan Sanson (Nice) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Philipp Kohn.
37' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
36' Referee Eric Wattellier is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Nice!
36' Celebrations by Nice are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
35' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
35' Eric Wattellier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) and blew his whistle. PENALTY AWARDED to Nice!
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jordan Lotomba (Nice) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' Tom Louchet (Nice) takes the corner but it's cleared.

32' Morgan Sanson (Nice) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Philipp Kohn makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play. Nice win a corner kick.
30' Eric Wattellier blows for a foul after Mohamed Camara (Monaco) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
28' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

28' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
26' The resulting corner from Tom Louchet (Nice) is cleared by the defence.
26' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. Nice have a corner.
22' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Evann Guessand (Nice) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Philipp Kohn was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
20' Dante (Nice) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
20' Tom Louchet (Nice) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
20' Tom Louchet (Nice) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
16' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Denis Zakaria (Monaco) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the right post. Mohamed Camara provided an assist for the goal.
14' Dangerous play by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco). Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
9' Eric Wattellier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Evann Guessand (Nice).
7' Excellent touch by Gaetan Laborde (Nice)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
5' Morgan Sanson (Nice) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Eric Wattellier saw the whole situation.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Monaco will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Eric Wattellier.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
